note: 学习目标与理解测验（讲稿 v2；审查与测验都对照它）。题目以迁移题为主，干扰项来自真实误解；前测、看片、后测、讲回来。AI 学生只用来筛题，最终以真人盲测为准。

objectives.zh: 能说出手机芯片由外到里是什么：黑色外壳（封装）底下一排焊球接主板；里面一片薄薄的硅，干活的一面朝下；这一面上，最底下是一两百亿个开关，上面压着十几层导线
objectives.en: Describe a phone chip from outside in: a black package sitting on solder balls; inside, a thin slice of silicon, working side down; on that side, tens of billions of switches at the bottom with a dozen-plus layers of wiring on top

objectives.zh: 知道导线为什么分层、为什么上粗下细：上面粗的送电、跑远路，越往下越细越密，通到每个开关
objectives.en: Explain why the wiring is layered thick-to-thin: thick upper layers carry power and long-distance signals; thinner, denser layers reach each individual switch

objectives.zh: 能以增强型N型MOS为例解释开关通断：没有栅压时源漏间没有连续电子通道；栅极隔着极薄绝缘层加电压，电场把硅里的电子吸到绝缘层附近形成通道；撤压后通道消失；没有机械零件在动，关态也不等于绝对零漏电
objectives.en: Explain switching using an enhancement-mode N-channel MOSFET: with no gate voltage there is no continuous electron channel between source and drain; voltage on the insulated gate attracts electrons in the silicon toward the insulator to form a channel; removing it makes the channel disappear; no mechanical part moves, and off does not mean literally zero leakage

objectives.zh: 知道为什么用普通显微镜看不到晶体管（光的波长比它们宽得多），以及科普画面里的颜色是后加的
objectives.en: Know why an ordinary microscope can't show a transistor (light's wavelength is far wider than it) and that the colors in such images are added

objectives.zh: 对尺度有感觉：栅极间距约50纳米、一根头发宽排得下上千根；一片纳米片只有四十几层原子厚；「3纳米」是代号，不直接对应某个物理尺寸
objectives.en: Have a feel for the scale: gates about 50 nm apart, over a thousand across a hair; a nanosheet only forty-some atoms thick; "3 nm" is a process name, not a direct physical dimension

quiz.zh: 朋友拆开手机，指着主板上一块黑色方块说「这就是芯片」。更准确的说法是？
quiz.en: A friend opens a phone, points at a black square on the board and says "that's the chip." What's more accurate?

zh: A 对，黑色那块就是芯片本身
B 那是外壳，真正的芯片是里面一片薄硅
C 芯片是那块绿色的电路板
D 芯片在黑块上面的金属盖里
en: A Yes, the black block is the chip itself
B That's the package; the real chip is a thin slice of silicon inside
C The chip is the green circuit board
D The chip is in the metal lid on top of the black block

quiz.zh: 一座城市修路：要把电和货物从城外运到每家门口。照芯片导线的办法，路应该怎么修？
quiz.en: A city has to bring power and goods from outside to every doorstep. Following how chip wiring works, how should the roads be built?

zh: A 只修一种宽度的路，铺满全城
B 上层修宽的干道跑远路，越靠近家门越细越密
C 全修细小巷，越多越好
D 每家拉一条直通城外的专线
en: A One width of road everywhere
B Wide highways for long distances, getting narrower and denser closer to each door
C Only tiny alleys, as many as possible
D A private line from every home straight out of town

quiz.zh: 老式继电器开关靠一块铁片被吸过去接通。芯片里的晶体管没有任何会动的零件，它靠什么接通？
quiz.en: An old relay connects when a piece of iron is pulled over. A chip's transistor has no moving parts. What makes it connect?

zh: A 里面有更小的铁片在动
B 栅极电压用电场把硅里的电子聚成通道
C 电流从栅极直接流进硅里
D 硅片受热膨胀，两头碰上
en: A Even tinier iron pieces move inside
B The gate's voltage uses an electric field to gather electrons in the silicon into a channel
C Current flows straight from the gate into the silicon
D The silicon heats up and expands until the ends touch

quiz.misconception: 栅极把电流灌进去 / 总得有东西在动

quiz.zh: 如果把栅极和硅之间那层极薄的绝缘层拿掉，最可能出什么问题？
quiz.en: If you removed the very thin insulator between the gate and the silicon, what would most likely go wrong?

zh: A 没问题，开关照样工作
B 栅极的电会直接漏进硅里，开关控制不住
C 晶体管会变得更快
D 硅会变成金属
en: A Nothing; it still switches fine
B Current would leak straight from the gate into the silicon and the switch couldn't be controlled
C The transistor would get faster
D The silicon would turn into metal

quiz.zh: 有人说「只要光学显微镜倍数够大，就能拍清手机芯片里的晶体管」。为什么不行？
quiz.en: Someone says "with enough magnification, an optical microscope could photograph a phone chip's transistors." Why not?

zh: A 芯片外壳挡住了
B 光的波长比晶体管宽得多，再放大也是糊的
C 晶体管是透明的
D 晶体管动得太快
en: A The package blocks the view
B Light's wavelength is much wider than a transistor, so it stays blurry however much you magnify
C Transistors are transparent
D Transistors move too fast

quiz.zh: 一款手机芯片宣传「3纳米工艺」。下面哪句对？
quiz.en: A phone chip is advertised as "3 nm." Which statement is right?

zh: A 里面每个晶体管都是3纳米大
B 栅极之间正好隔3纳米
C 「3纳米」是工艺代号，不直接对应某个物理尺寸
D 导线宽3纳米
en: A Every transistor is 3 nm across
B Gates are exactly 3 nm apart
C "3 nm" is a process name and does not directly correspond to a physical dimension
D The wires are 3 nm wide

pass_rule: 每个目标至少一道题后测答对；Q3、Q4都对才算O3过（本期重点）

explain_back.zh: 看完请用三五句话给朋友讲：手机芯片里面有什么？晶体管这个开关是怎么通、怎么断的？
explain_back.en: In three to five sentences, tell a friend what's inside a phone chip, and how a transistor switches on and off.
must_mention: 外壳里一片薄硅 / 倒扣
最底下一两百亿个开关、上面十几层导线
栅压经绝缘层用电场聚成沟道（不是零件在动）
